reasoning: Two successful audits (deepseek-v4-flash and openrouter/free advisory) independently reviewed all four repository files and found no security issues. The PKGBUILD is a standard -bin package that downloads official .deb releases from the upstream jgraph/drawio-desktop GitHub repository with pinned SHA256 checksums. The prepare() and package() functions perform routine operations (extracting .deb, adjusting desktop file paths, installing to /opt, creating symlink). The Makefile contains only standard maintainer helper targets (update, clean, test, publish). No code injection, no suspicious network requests, no obfuscated content.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement (inconclusive vs safe) was caused by tool errors in the qwen3-235b model, which failed with HTTP 400 errors when attempting to review the PKGBUILD and Makefile files. The other two models successfully reviewed all files and agreed the package is safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review PKGBUILD and Makefile due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors, resulting in an inconclusive verdict
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback models when LLM API requests fail with HTTP 400 errors to prevent inconclusive verdicts due to transient tool failures
When a model fails to review critical files (PKGBUILD, Makefile), the audit tool should clearly flag this as a coverage gap rather than just marking individual files as inconclusive
